cell.name: string-proximity
cell.note: offsets 1 and 3 = one token between the terms

diff_summary: the index is missing 8 document(s): k009, k012, k043, k046, k077, k080, k095, k099
index_query: FOR doc IN pd_view SEARCH PHRASE(doc.s, "quick", 1, "fox", 3, "text_en") SORT doc._key RETURN doc
scan_query: FOR doc IN pd_fixture LET t = TOKENS(doc.s, "text_en") FILTER LENGTH(t) >= 3 AND LENGTH(FOR i IN 0..MAX([LENGTH(t) - 3, 0]) FILTER t[i] == "quick" AND t[i + 2] == "fox" LIMIT 1 RETURN 1) > 0 SORT doc._key RETURN doc
